svg.aria-label: Cipherlink: an end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer messenger on MLS (RFC 9420) over WebRTC that treats its own key directory as untrusted; 140 tests including an adversarial-server suite. The picture is its verification dialog: a 60-digit safety number and a QR code.
svg.title: Cipherlink: an end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer messenger on MLS (RFC 9420) over WebRTC that treats its own key directory as untrusted; 140 tests including an adversarial-server suite. The picture is its verification dialog: a 60-digit safety number and a QR code.
svg.text: An end-to-end encrypted messenger on MLS (RFC
9420) over WebRTC that treats its own key directory
as untrusted: safety numbers verify each device, and
outgoing messages are held when a key changes.
